name: Nisien
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Nisien is a Welsh hero or god. He was the gentle half brother of Brân the Blessed and wished only the best for everyone. His brother Efnisien was his opposite, a being who made mischief of every kind. Efnisien started the great war that ended with Brân's death in Ireland. His cruelty made the king of that land turn against Wales forever. Nisien sought to mend the trouble and to say words of apology for his brother, but his effort came to nothing. Nisien plays a small part in the Welsh tales recorded in the Mabinogion and may serve simply as a good contrast to his evil brother.
